# WB6 · Điều phối lịch · 7 ngày

Group **WB · Vận hành: tổng quan, hôm nay, lịch** · state · Next.js: **built (U2)** (`/schedule`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#schedule`
- Operations pages are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (dashboard, today) and `operations-ui.js` (schedule and the booking dialogs); calculations live in `PemaCRM` and `PemaOps` (`operations-data.js`).
- Same `schedule()` with `view = 'week'`: seven `week-day` columns starting at the chosen date, each with a title "CN, 20/09" and the day's bookings.
- Inventory note: Seven day columns, each with its count, cards and "＋ Đặt lịch". Every day of the demo week has bookings, so the empty-day text "Chưa có lịch" exists in code only.
- Page key `schedule` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"schedule\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"view\"][data-value=\"week\"]"}; it must show `.week-grid`.

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="owner-tam">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Điều phối lịch", page key "schedule"
  <PageHeading title="Điều phối lịch" subtitle="Xếp theo phòng, ca bác sĩ và thời lượng. Kéo lịch hoặc mở chi tiết để dời.">
    <Button variant="primary" icon="plus" old="btn btn-primary">"Đặt lịch"</Button>  // ops=new
  </PageHeading>
  <Row old="ops-stats" wrap>
    <Tile old="ops-stat" label="Lịch trong ngày" value="31" />
    <Tile old="ops-stat" label="Thời gian điều trị" value="1275′" />
    <Tile old="ops-stat" label="Chờ xếp lịch" value="6" />
    <Tile old="ops-stat" label="Khoảng khóa" value="0" />
  </Row>
  <Row old="ops-toolbar" gap="10px" wrap>
    <Row old="actions" gap="8px" wrap>
      <Button variant="secondary" aria-label="Ngày trước" old="btn">"←"</Button>  // ops=previous
      <Field label="Ngày bắt đầu" type="date" default="2026-09-20" id="ops-date" />
      <Button variant="secondary" aria-label="Ngày tiếp theo" old="btn">"→"</Button>  // ops=next
      <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Mốc demo"</Button>  // ops=today
    </Row>
    <Row old="ops-toggle" gap="4px">
      <FilterChipGroup items={["Ngày","7 ngày"]} selected={["7 ngày"]} />  // ops
    </Row>
    <Field label="Bác sĩ" type="select" default="Tất cả bác sĩ" id="ops-doctor" options={["Tất cả bác sĩ","BS. Tâm","BS. Mai","BS. An","BS. Lan"]} />
    <Field label="Phòng" type="select" default="Tất cả phòng" id="ops-room" options={["Tất cả phòng","Khám da liễu","Tư vấn chuyên sâu","Laser & thủ thuật","Chăm sóc da"]} />
  </Row>
  <Grid old="ops-layout" cols="minmax(0px, 1fr) 250px" gap="14px">
    <Card old="panel calendar-panel" title="20/9/2026 — 26/9/2026" subtitle="08:00–18:00 · bước kéo 30 phút · nhấp thẻ để chỉnh giờ chính xác">
      <Card.Aside>
        <Badge tone="neutral" old="chip">"Theo ngày"</Badge>
      </Card.Aside>
      <Grid old="week-grid" cols="repeat(7, minmax(178px, 1fr))">

          <Text old="week-title"><Strong>"CN, 20/09"</Strong> <Small>"31 lịch"</Small></Text>
          <Repeat of=".booking" count={31} also-classes="service-S0 service-S1 service-S2 service-S3">  // first item shown (demo values); the others have the same shape
            <Button variant="secondary" aria-label="Mở hoặc kéo để dời lịch" title="Mở hoặc kéo để dời lịch" draggable old="booking service-S0">"08:00–08:30 Nguyễn Minh Linh Tái khám & đánh giá"</Button>  // ops=edit
          </Repeat>
          <Button variant="secondary" icon="plus" old="btn">"Đặt lịch"</Button>  // ops=new
          <RowVariants>actions "08:00–08:30 Đặng Gia Hân Tái khám & đánh giá" (secondary, ops=edit) ×40, 40 different labels, "Đặt lịch" (secondary, ops=new) ×6</RowVariants>
        </Repeat>
      </Grid>
      <Row old="calendar-legend" gap="8px" wrap>
        <Text old="service-S0">"Tái khám & đánh giá"</Text>
        <Text old="service-S1">"Tư vấn da liễu"</Text>
        <Text old="service-S2">"Laser theo chỉ định"</Text>
        <Text old="service-S3">"Chăm sóc theo chỉ định"</Text>
      </Row>
    </Card>
    <Card old="panel" title="Chờ xếp lịch" subtitle="Chọn hồ sơ để tìm giờ phù hợp">
      <Repeat of=".wait-card" count={6}>  // first item shown (demo values); the others have the same shape
        <Card old="wait-card" layout="grid 1fr auto">
          <Row old="patient-mini" gap="8px">

</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Button×7, Tile×4, Field×3, Card×3, PageHeading×1, Badge×1; shared pieces: FilterChip×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.
